title: Kenyan Grilled Pea Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Kenya that combines the sweetness of peas with the smokiness of grilled meat.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of light oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the peas and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Season with salt, black pepper, and grill seasoning.
